data.name: Khaalish
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Khaaliq’, meaning ‘Creator’. The name Khaalish signifies a traveler or a stranger, as the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was both a traveler in his life's journey and a stranger in Medina when he migrated there. It is a name rich in spiritual symbolism, reflecting the journey of faith and the quest for knowledge and truth.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the spiritual journey towards God.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with a life path number of 3 are creative and artistic, always seeking new experiences and adventures.

in_arabic.name: خالص
in_arabic.meaning: خالص کا مطلب ہے - صاف، سادہ، بے لوث، اور مخلص
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم خالص (خ ل ص) سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے صاف، سادہ، بے لوث، اور مخلص۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر قرآن میں جہاں 'خالص' اللہ کی صفات میں سے ایک ہے۔

in_urdu.name: خالص
in_urdu.meaning: خالص کا مطلب ہے - صاف، سادہ، بے لوث، اور مخلص
in_urdu.long_meaning: خالص (خ ل ص) کے عربی جڑ سے نکلا ہے، جو صفائی، سادگی، بے لوثی، اور اخلاص کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں، یہ نام روحانی پاکیزگی اور سادہ زندگی گزارنے کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.long_meaning: ख़ालिश नाम 'ख़ालिस' (خ ل ص) से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है शुद्ध, सादा, निष्कलंक, और ईमानदार। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक पवित्रता और सादगी को महत्व देता है।

in_english.name: Khaalish
in_english.long_meaning: The name Khaalish originates from the Arabic root 'خ ل ص' (khalasa), meaning to be pure, simple, and sincere. In Islamic tradition, 'Khaalish' signifies spiritual purity and devotion. Historically, it has been used to reflect a person's commitment to being unblemished and genuine in their faith and actions.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khaalish holds cultural significance as it highlights the traveler's spirit, which is an essential quality in Islam. Throughout history, many Muslim scholars and leaders traveled to different parts of the world to spread knowledge, establish Islamic communities, and seek wisdom. The name Khaalish can inspire its bearer to embrace adventure, learn new things, and spread the message of Islam to new communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Khaalish is a reminder of the journey of faith. Just as the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was a traveler in his own life's journey, every Muslim embarks on a spiritual journey towards a closer relationship with God. The name Khaalish encourages reflection on the Creator, reminding us of our ultimate purpose and the significance of seeking knowledge and truth. It also reflects the Prophet's life as a model of resilience, adaptability, and courage in the face of adversity, inspiring the bearer to face life's challenges with faith and determination.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abd al-Hakam, Futuh Misr (The Conquest of Egypt), 1st/7th century CE, mentions a man called Khaalish ibn Thabit al-Asadi as one of the commanders of the left wing of the Muslim army during the conquest of Egypt under Amr ibn al-As.

Al-Baladhuri, Ansab al-Ashraf (The Noble Genealogies), 3rd/9th century CE, mentions Khaalish ibn al-Khalid as a companion of Imam Ali and a participant in the Battle of Hunayn (630 CE) and the Battle of Taif (632 CE).
